append-empty-a4-page-to-pdf.title: Append Empty A4 Page to PDF
append-empty-a4-page-to-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, add a new empty A4‑sized page at the end of the document, and save the updated file.

insert-blank-page-at-index-three.title: Insert Blank Page at Specific Position in PDF
insert-blank-page-at-index-three.description: Demonstrates how to insert a new blank page at position 3 in an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PageCollection.Insert method.

insert-page-matching-page2-size.title: Insert New Page with Same Size as Page 2
insert-page-matching-page2-size.description: Loads a PDF, copies the size and margins from the second page, inserts a blank page at position five, and applies the copied dimensions to the new page.

add-multiple-empty-pages-to-pdf.title: Add Multiple Empty Pages Sequentially to PDF
add-multiple-empty-pages-to-pdf.description: Shows how to add a series of empty pages to a PDF by iterating over a list of page counts and respecting the Aspose.Pdf evaluation page limit.

read-pdf-page-dimensions.title: Read PDF Page Width and Height
read-pdf-page-dimensions.description: The example opens a PDF file, iterates through each page, and logs the page's width and height in points using Aspose.Pdf.

resize-pdf-page-to-letter-size.title: Resize PDF Page to Letter Size
resize-pdf-page-to-letter-size.description: Shows how to load a PDF, ensure it has at least seven pages, and change page 7 to Letter dimensions (8.5" x 11") using Aspose.Pdf.

resize-pdf-pages-to-a5.title: Resize PDF Pages to A5 Size
resize-pdf-pages-to-a5.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, loop through its PageCollection, set each page to A5 dimensions, and save the result.

rotate-fourth-page-90-degrees-clockwise.title: Rotate Specific PDF Page by 90 Degrees
rotate-fourth-page-90-degrees-clockwise.description: Shows how to load a PDF, verify it has at least four pages, rotate the fourth page 90° clockwise, and save the modified document.

convert-odd-pages-landscape-to-portrait.title: Convert Odd Pages from Landscape to Portrait
convert-odd-pages-landscape-to-portrait.description: Loads a PDF, iterates over odd‑numbered pages and swaps their MediaBox dimensions to change landscape pages to portrait orientation, then saves the result.

move-page-9-to-first-position.title: Move Page 9 to First Position in PDF
move-page-9-to-first-position.description: Demonstrates how to reorder PDF pages by moving the ninth page to the first position using Aspose.Pdf's Insert and Delete methods on the PageCollection.

reorder-pdf-pages-custom-sequence.title: Reorder PDF Pages Using a Custom Sequence
reorder-pdf-pages-custom-sequence.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, validate a custom 1‑based page order array, copy pages into a new document in that order, and save the reordered file.

delete-last-three-pages-from-pdf.title: Delete Last Three Pages from PDF
delete-last-three-pages-from-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, remove the last three pages using PageCollection.Delete, and save the modified document.

delete-page-range-from-pdf.title: Delete a Range of PDF Pages
delete-page-range-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to remove pages 5 through 10 from a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf and save the modified file.

insert-custom-sized-page-at-beginning.title: Insert Empty Page with Custom Size at Beginning of PDF
insert-custom-sized-page-at-beginning.description: Demonstrates how to insert a blank page at the start of an existing PDF and set its dimensions to 200 × 300 points using Aspose.Pdf.

append-page-to-pdf.title: Append a Page from One PDF to Another
append-page-to-pdf.description: Shows how to append a page from a source PDF to the end of a target PDF using Aspose.Pdf without altering the existing content.

duplicate-third-page-in-pdf.title: Duplicate Page Three in PDF
duplicate-third-page-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to duplicate the third page of a PDF and insert the copy immediately after it using Aspose.Pdf.

rotate-all-pdf-pages-180-degrees.title: Rotate All PDF Pages 180 Degrees
rotate-all-pdf-pages-180-degrees.description: Shows how to rotate every page of a PDF document by 180° using Aspose.Pdf and save the result.

convert-pdf-pages-portrait-to-landscape.title: Convert PDF Pages from Portrait to Landscape
convert-pdf-pages-portrait-to-landscape.description: Shows how to change each PDF page to landscape orientation by swapping the MediaBox width and height using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-blank-pages-after-each-page.title: Insert Blank Page After Each PDF Page
insert-blank-pages-after-each-page.description: Demonstrates how to double a PDF's page count by inserting a blank page after every existing page using Aspose.Pdf.

rotate-pdf-pages-by-parity.title: Rotate Even PDF Pages by 90 Degrees
rotate-pdf-pages-by-parity.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through its pages, and rotates every even‑numbered page 90° clockwise while leaving odd pages unchanged, then saves the result.

export-pdf-page-dimensions-to-csv.title: Export PDF Page Dimensions to CSV
export-pdf-page-dimensions-to-csv.description: Demonstrates how to read each page's width and height from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and write the data to a CSV file for external analysis.

insert-page-from-another-pdf.title: Insert Page from Another PDF at Specific Index
insert-page-from-another-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to insert a page from a source PDF into a target PDF at position 2 while keeping the original page size and rotation.

set-custom-size-first-pdf-page.title: Resize First PDF Page to Custom Dimensions
set-custom-size-first-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to set a custom page size (500 × 700 points) for the first page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

rotate-pdf-pages-reverse-order.title: Rotate PDF Pages in Reverse Order
rotate-pdf-pages-reverse-order.description: Shows how to load a PDF, iterate its pages from last to first, rotate each page 90° clockwise, and save the modified document.

move-pdf-pages-to-end.title: Move Specific PDF Pages to End
move-pdf-pages-to-end.description: Shows how to move pages 3 through 6 of a PDF document to the end using Aspose.Pdf in C#.

copy-mediabox-page-8-to-12.title: Copy MediaBox from Page 8 to Page 12
copy-mediabox-page-8-to-12.description: Demonstrates how to read the MediaBox of one PDF page and apply it to another page using Aspose.Pdf, ensuring both pages share the same dimensions.

insert-ten-empty-pages-at-pdf-midpoint.title: Insert Ten Empty Pages at PDF Midpoint
insert-ten-empty-pages-at-pdf-midpoint.description: Shows how to calculate the middle of a PDF document and batch‑insert ten blank pages using Aspose.Pdf.

resize-wide-pdf-pages-to-a4.title: Resize Wide PDF Pages to A4 Size
resize-wide-pdf-pages-to-a4.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate its pages, and resize only pages wider than 600 points to A4 dimensions, leaving narrower pages unchanged.

delete-pdf-pages-from-config.title: Delete Specific Pages from PDF Using Aspose.Pdf
delete-pdf-pages-from-config.description: Shows how to read page numbers from a configuration file and remove those pages from a PDF document with Aspose.Pdf.

reorder-pdf-pages-descending.title: Reorder PDF Pages in Descending Order
reorder-pdf-pages-descending.description: Shows how to load a PDF, sort its pages in descending numeric order, and save the reordered document using Aspose.Pdf.

convert-pdf-pages-to-portrait.title: Convert PDF Pages to Portrait Orientation
convert-pdf-pages-to-portrait.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through each page, and changes any landscape page to portrait by swapping the MediaBox width and height before saving the document.

rotate-every-third-pdf-page-90-degrees.title: Rotate Every Third PDF Page by 90 Degrees
rotate-every-third-pdf-page-90-degrees.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through its pages, rotate pages whose number is divisible by three by 90°, and save the modified document.

delete-first-page-from-pdf.title: Delete First Page from PDF
delete-first-page-from-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, delete the first page, and save the modified document.

resize-pdf-pages-uniform-size.title: Resize PDF Pages to Uniform Size
resize-pdf-pages-uniform-size.description: Shows how to determine the largest page width and height in a PDF and then set every page to those dimensions using Aspose.Pdf.

reset-page-rotation.title: Reset PDF Page Rotation
reset-page-rotation.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, select a specific page, reset its rotation to the original orientation, and save the updated document.

extract-resize-reinsert-pdf-pages.title: Extract, Resize, and Reinsert PDF Pages
extract-resize-reinsert-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to extract a range of pages from a PDF, change each page size to A4, and reinsert the pages at a new position within the same document using Aspose.Pdf.

move-even-pages-to-end.title: Reorder PDF Pages: Move Even Pages to End
move-even-pages-to-end.description: Shows how to reorder a PDF by moving all even‑numbered pages to the end while keeping the original relative order using Aspose.Pdf.

resize-pdf-pages-to-template-size.title: Resize PDF Pages to Match Template Size
resize-pdf-pages-to-template-size.description: Demonstrates how to resize every page of a PDF to the dimensions of a reference template PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

rotate-pdf-pages-using-config.title: Rotate PDF Pages by Configurable Angles
rotate-pdf-pages-using-config.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, rotating individual pages based on a dictionary of page numbers and angles, and saving the result.

insert-transparent-separator-page.title: Add Empty Separator Page to PDF
insert-transparent-separator-page.description: Shows how to insert an empty page with a transparent background into an existing PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

delete-last-page-from-pdfs.title: Delete Last Page from PDFs in a Folder
delete-last-page-from-pdfs.description: Shows how to enumerate PDF files in a directory, remove the last page of each document using Aspose.Pdf, and overwrite the original files.

move-pdf-page-to-another-document.title: Move a Page Between PDFs Preserving Rotation and Size
move-pdf-page-to-another-document.description: Demonstrates how to transfer a single page from one PDF document to another while keeping its original rotation and dimensions, then saves both updated PDFs.

crop-pdf-page-media-box.title: Crop PDF Page by Adjusting MediaBox
crop-pdf-page-media-box.description: Shows how to modify a page's MediaBox to create a custom cropping region without altering the page's content.

batch-resize-pdf-pages-fixed-width.title: Resize PDF Pages to Fixed Width While Preserving Aspect Ratio
batch-resize-pdf-pages-fixed-width.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through each page, and sets a new width of 800 points while scaling the height to keep the original aspect ratio, then saves the result.

delete-specified-pdf-pages.title: Delete PDF Pages from List
delete-specified-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to read page numbers from a text file and delete those pages from a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

reorder-pdf-pages-by-orientation.title: Reorder PDF Pages by Orientation
reorder-pdf-pages-by-orientation.description: Shows how to separate landscape and portrait pages in a PDF and create a new document with all landscape pages first followed by portrait pages using Aspose.Pdf.

add-blank-front-matter-page-roman-label.title: Add Blank Page and Custom Page Label to PDF
add-blank-front-matter-page-roman-label.description: Shows how to insert a blank page into an existing PDF with Aspose.Pdf and explains how to assign a custom page label (e.g., lower‑case Roman numeral "i") via an upgraded API or a visual text workaround.

resize-pdf-pages-to-printable-area.title: Resize PDF Pages to Fit Printable Area
resize-pdf-pages-to-printable-area.description: Shows how to load a PDF, calculate a uniform scale factor, and resize each page to a target printable area of 595 × 842 points using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-empty-page-with-custom-size.title: Insert Custom-Sized Empty Page into PDF
insert-empty-page-with-custom-size.description: Shows how to read user-provided width and height, add an empty page with those dimensions to an existing PDF, and save the result using Aspose.Pdf.

add-header-to-first-pdf-page.title: Add Header to First PDF Page Using MarginInfo
add-header-to-first-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to add a text header to the first page of a PDF document by configuring a HeaderFooter with a MarginInfo object and saving the result.

add-html-header-to-first-three-pdf-pages.title: Add HTML Header with CSS to First Three PDF Pages
add-html-header-to-first-three-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to insert an HTML fragment with embedded CSS as a header on the first three pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-image-footer-with-scaling-to-pdf-pag.title: Add Scaled Image Footer to PDF Pages
add-image-footer-with-scaling-to-pdf-pag.description: Demonstrates how to add a footer image to every page of a PDF and scale it using Aspose.Pdf's ImageStamp.

add-image-footer-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Image Footer with Opacity to PDF Pages
add-image-footer-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to place a semi‑transparent image footer on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's ImageStamp and page stamping features.

add-generation-date-footer-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Generation Date Footer to PDF Pages
add-generation-date-footer-to-pdf-pages.description: Loads a PDF, creates a text fragment with the current date, places it as a footer on each page, and saves the updated document.

add-diagonal-text-watermark-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Diagonal Text Watermark to PDF Pages
add-diagonal-text-watermark-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to place a semi‑transparent diagonal text watermark on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-rotated-image-watermark-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Rotated Image Watermark to PDF Pages
add-rotated-image-watermark-to-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to overlay a semi‑transparent PNG watermark on each page of a PDF, rotating it 45° and scaling it to half the page size using Aspose.Pdf.

add-image-watermark-with-opacity-to-pdf-.title: Add Image Watermark to PDF Pages
add-image-watermark-with-opacity-to-pdf-.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, create an ImageStamp with 20% opacity, and apply it as a background watermark to every page before saving the result.

add-repeating-image-watermark-to-pdf-pag.title: Add Repeating Image Watermark Grid to PDF Pages
add-repeating-image-watermark-to-pdf-pag.description: Shows how to overlay a semi‑transparent image watermark repeatedly across each page of a PDF by placing ImageStamp objects in a grid pattern using Aspose.Pdf.

add-year-text-watermark-to-pdf.title: Add Current Year Text Watermark to PDF
add-year-text-watermark-to-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, create a TextStamp that includes the current year, apply it to every page, and save the watermarked document.

add-curved-text-watermark-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Curved Text Watermark to PDF Pages
add-curved-text-watermark-to-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to generate a quadratic Bézier curve and place semi‑transparent TextStamp objects at each point to create a curved watermark across every PDF page.

add-semi-transparent-text-watermark.title: Add Semi-Transparent Text Watermark to PDF Pages
add-semi-transparent-text-watermark.description: Demonstrates how to add a centered, semi‑transparent text watermark to each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-lightgray-background-to-pdf-pages.title: Add LightGray Background to PDF Pages
add-lightgray-background-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to apply a LightGray background color to every page of a PDF by drawing a full‑page rectangle using Aspose.Pdf.

set-transparent-background-for-pdf-pages.title: Set PDF Page Background to Transparent
set-transparent-background-for-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to ensure PDF pages have a transparent background using Aspose.Pdf by loading a document and saving it without applying an explicit background color.

set-pdf-page-background-cmyk.title: Set PDF Page Background Color Using CMYK Values
set-pdf-page-background-cmyk.description: Shows how to open a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, create a CMYK color, apply it as the background for each page, and save the modified document.

add-page-numbers-to-pdf.title: Add Page Numbers to PDF Using Aspose.Pdf
add-page-numbers-to-pdf.description: Shows how to insert a centered page number stamp on each page of a PDF, starting at 1, using Aspose.Pdf in C#.

add-roman-numeral-page-numbers.title: Add Roman Numeral Page Numbers to Introductory PDF Pages
add-roman-numeral-page-numbers.description: Shows how to insert page numbers in Roman numerals on the first few pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, including positioning and styling of the text.

add-chapter-page-numbers-to-pdf.title: Add Chapter Page Numbers to PDF
add-chapter-page-numbers-to-pdf.description: Shows how to open a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, loop through each page, and insert a custom "Chapter" prefix page number at the bottom‑right corner before saving the document.

insert-page-numbers-leading-zeros.title: Add Leading-Zero Page Numbers to PDF
insert-page-numbers-leading-zeros.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through each page, formats the page index with a leading zero (e.g., 01, 02) and adds it as a text fragment positioned near the bottom‑center, then saves the modified document.

add-custom-page-numbers-to-pdf.title: Insert Page Numbers in PDF (Page X of Y)
add-custom-page-numbers-to-pdf.description: Shows how to add a custom footer with the format "Page X of Y" to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-custom-page-numbers-pdf.title: Add Page Numbers (current/total) to PDF
insert-custom-page-numbers-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through its pages, and insert a page number in the format "current/total" at a specified position, then save the result.

add-superscript-page-numbers-to-pdf.title: Add Superscript Footnote Page Numbers to PDF
add-superscript-page-numbers-to-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through each page, and inserts a small superscript‑styled page number near the bottom left as a footnote reference, then saves the updated document.

insert-page-numbers-arial-font.title: Add Page Numbers with Arial Font to PDF
insert-page-numbers-arial-font.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, iterate through its pages, and insert page numbers using the Arial font at size 14 points, then save the updated document.

add-page-numbers-with-custom-embedded-fo.title: Add Page Numbers with Embedded Custom Font to PDF
add-page-numbers-with-custom-embedded-fo.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, embed an external TrueType font, and add page numbers using that custom font at the bottom‑right of each page.

add-page-numbers-to-odd-pdf-pages.title: Add Page Numbers to Odd PDF Pages
add-page-numbers-to-odd-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to insert page numbers only on odd-numbered pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf in C#.

add-page-numbers-to-even-pdf-pages.title: Add Page Numbers to Even PDF Pages
add-page-numbers-to-even-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to insert page numbers only on even pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf by iterating through the document pages and adding a TextFragment to each even page.

add-bates-numbering-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Bates Numbering to PDF Pages
add-bates-numbering-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to insert year‑based Bates numbers (e.g., 2026‑0001) on each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's TextStamp.

add-bates-numbering-with-custom-prefix-s.title: Add Custom Bates Numbering to PDF Pages
add-bates-numbering-with-custom-prefix-s.description: Demonstrates applying sequential Bates numbers with a custom prefix and suffix to each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-bates-numbering-with-prefix.title: Add Bates Numbering with Prefix to PDF Pages
add-bates-numbering-with-prefix.description: Demonstrates how to apply sequential Bates numbers with an alphanumeric prefix to each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-add-bates-numbering-to-pdf-pages.title: Batch Bates Numbering for PDFs
batch-add-bates-numbering-to-pdf-pages.description: Processes all PDF files in a folder, adding a Bates number stamp to each page with a configurable increment of 5, optional prefix/suffix, zero‑padding, and saves the stamped PDFs to an output folder.

remove-bates-numbering-add-new-sequence.title: Replace Bates Numbering Stamps in PDF
remove-bates-numbering-add-new-sequence.description: Demonstrates how to clear existing stamp annotations from each PDF page and apply a new sequential Bates number stamp using Aspose.Pdf.

remove-bates-numbering-from-selected-pdf.title: Remove Specific Bates Number Stamp from PDF Pages
remove-bates-numbering-from-selected-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to locate and delete a StampAnnotation containing a given Bates number on selected PDF pages using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-pdf-headers-footers.title: Replace PDF Headers and Footers
replace-pdf-headers-footers.description: Demonstrates how to remove any existing headers and footers from all pages of a PDF, create new header and footer objects (including page number placeholders), and apply them to each page using Aspose.Pdf.

read-pdf-page-count.title: Read Total Page Count from PDF
read-pdf-page-count.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and retrieve the total number of pages without saving the document.

adjust-pdf-bleedbox-for-printer-specs.title: Adjust PDF BleedBox for Printer Specifications
adjust-pdf-bleedbox-for-printer-specs.description: Shows how to read each page's BleedBox, expand it by a margin to meet printer requirements, and save the modified PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

retrieve-trimbox-after-cropping-pdf-page.title: Retrieve and Set TrimBox Values for PDF Pages
retrieve-trimbox-after-cropping-pdf-page.description: Shows how to load a PDF, optionally set a new TrimBox for each page, and read the TrimBox coordinates to verify the content area after cropping.

crop-pdf-pages-remove-margins.title: Crop PDF Pages to Remove Margins
crop-pdf-pages-remove-margins.description: Shows how to trim margins from every page of a PDF by setting the CropBox rectangle using Aspose.Pdf.

extend-bleedbox-beyond-cropbox.title: Extend BleedBox Beyond CropBox in PDF
extend-bleedbox-beyond-cropbox.description: Demonstrates how to set each page's BleedBox to extend 5 points beyond the existing CropBox using Aspose.Pdf, then saves the modified document.

trim-white-space-from-pdf-pages.title: Load PDF and Iterate Pages (Trim Placeholder)
trim-white-space-from-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterating through its pages, and saving the document, while noting that the Page.Trim method is unavailable in the current library version.

trim-white-margins-pixel-tolerance.title: Trim PDF Pages with Custom Pixel Tolerance
trim-white-margins-pixel-tolerance.description: Shows how to trim the visible area of each PDF page by setting a CropBox based on a per‑page pixel tolerance value.

crop-pdf-pages-to-4-3-aspect-ratio.title: Crop PDF Pages to 4:3 Aspect Ratio
crop-pdf-pages-to-4-3-aspect-ratio.description: Shows how to iterate through a PDF, calculate a 4:3 crop box for each page, and apply it using Aspose.Pdf.

add-header-logo-image-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Header Logo to PDF Pages
add-header-logo-image-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to place a logo image as a header on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's ImageStamp and page stamping features.

add-bold-uppercase-header-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Bold Uppercase Header to Each PDF Page
add-bold-uppercase-header-to-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through its pages, and add a centered bold uppercase header at the top of each page.
